components: A resumable cursor reads historical records in bounded batches.
Each record deterministically computes the missing representation.
Version checks avoid overwriting newer concurrent updates.
Rate and concurrency adapt to production headroom.
Coverage metrics and reconciliation identify omissions or drift.
